exact_v11_diagnostic_program_template.template:
set +e
set +x
umask 077
PHASE_C_DIAG_V11_HEAD='__V11_CANDIDATE_HEAD__'
PHASE_C_DIAG_V11_BLOB='__V11_ADDENDUM_BLOB__'
PHASE_C_DIAG_CANONICAL_MAIN='74ea95e59ac0654e1a0c1f811a178b3eef7b073c'
PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT='/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-first-api-diagnostic'
PHASE_C_DIAG_RESULT="$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT/result.json"
PHASE_C_DIAG_STDOUT="$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT/gh-api-user.stdout"
PHASE_C_DIAG_STDERR="$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT/gh-api-user.stderr"
test ! -e "$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT" && test ! -L "$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT" || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_V11_DIAGNOSTIC_ROOT_ALREADY_EXISTS_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 86; }
command mkdir -m 700 "$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT" || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_V11_DIAGNOSTIC_ROOT_CREATE_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 86; }
fs="$(command stat -f -c '%T' "$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT")"; { test "$fs" = 'tmpfs' || test "$fs" = 'ramfs'; } || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_V11_DIAGNOSTIC_ROOT_NOT_MEMORY_BACKED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 86; }
phase_c_verify
PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_RC=$?
if [ "$PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_RC" -ne 0 ]; then command printf '%s\n' "PHASE_C_V11_LOCAL_VERIFY_FAILED_RC=$PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_RC" >&2; exit 86; fi
gh api --hostname github.com --include -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' -H 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' --method GET /user >"$PHASE_C_DIAG_STDOUT" 2>"$PHASE_C_DIAG_STDERR"
PHASE_C_DIAG_GH_RC=$?
/usr/local/python/current/bin/python -B - "$PHASE_C_DIAG_RESULT" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_STDOUT" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_STDERR" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_GH_RC" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_V11_HEAD" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_V11_BLOB" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_CANONICAL_MAIN" "${CODESPACE_NAME:-}" "${GH_CONFIG_DIR:-}" "$EXEC_ROOT" <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,os,re,sys
(result_path,stdout_path,stderr_path,rc_s,v11_head,v11_blob,canonical_main,codespace_name,gh_config_dir,exec_root)=sys.argv[1:]
rc=int(rc_s)
out=open(stdout_path,"rb").read()
err=open(stderr_path,"rb").read()
err_text=err.decode("utf-8","replace")
low=err_text.lower()
def has(*xs):
    return any(x in low for x in xs)
if not err:
    err_class="EMPTY"
elif has("bad credentials","not logged into","authentication failed","requires authentication","http 401","oauth"):
    err_class="AUTHENTICATION_OR_CREDENTIAL"
elif has("could not resolve","no such host","temporary failure in name resolution","lookup api.github.com"):
    err_class="DNS_RESOLUTION"
elif has("timed out","timeout","deadline exceeded","context deadline"):
    err_class="TIMEOUT"
elif has("x509","certificate","tls","ssl"):
    err_class="TLS_OR_CERTIFICATE"
elif has("connection refused","connection reset","failed to connect","network is unreachable","connection closed","connection aborted"):
    err_class="NETWORK_CONNECTIVITY"
elif has("rate limit"):
    err_class="RATE_LIMIT"
elif has("unknown flag","usage: gh api","accepts "):
    err_class="CLI_USAGE"
elif has("http 4","http 5","gh:"):
    err_class="HTTP_OR_GH_ERROR"
else:
    err_class="OTHER"
status=None
scope_header=None
response_headers_present=False
if out:
    text=out.decode("utf-8","replace").replace("\r\n","\n")
    head,sep,body=text.partition("\n\n")
    if sep:
        response_headers_present=True
        lines=[x for x in head.splitlines() if x]
        if lines and lines[0].startswith("HTTP/"):
            try: status=int(lines[0].split()[1])
            except Exception: status=None
        for line in lines[1:]:
            if ":" in line:
                k,v=line.split(":",1)
                if k.strip().lower()=="x-oauth-scopes":
                    scope_header=v.strip()
report={
 "schema_version":"MULTIVERSE_R1_STAGE1_PHASE_C_FIRST_API_CHILD_OBSERVABILITY_RESULT_v1",
 "status":"PHASE_C_V11_FIRST_API_DIAGNOSTIC_CAPTURE_COMPLETE_NO_PREFLIGHT_RETRY_NO_STEP4",
 "binding":{
   "canonical_main_expected":canonical_main,
   "v11_candidate_head":v11_head,
   "v11_addendum_blob":v11_blob,
   "codespace_name":codespace_name,
   "gh_config_dir":gh_config_dir,
   "execution_root":exec_root
 },
 "local_phase_c_verify":{"rc":0},
 "first_user_api_attempt":{
   "command_semantics":"canonical gh api /user GET with include + reviewed headers",
   "attempt_count":1,
   "rc":rc,
   "stdout_bytes":len(out),
   "stdout_sha256":hashlib.sha256(out).hexdigest(),
   "stderr_bytes":len(err),
   "stderr_sha256":hashlib.sha256(err).hexdigest(),
   "stderr_classification":err_class,
   "response_headers_present":response_headers_present,
   "http_status":status,
   "x_oauth_scopes":scope_header
 },
 "stderr_text_disclosed":False,
 "stdout_body_disclosed":False,
 "canonical_preflight_rerun":False,
 "step4_delivered":False,
 "production_apply_invocations":0,
 "production_mutation_performed":False,
 "runtime_activation_performed":False
}
encoded=(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"))+"\n").encode()
fd=os.open(result_path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as f: f.write(encoded)
os.chmod(result_path,0o400)
print("PHASE_C_V11_DIAGNOSTIC_REPORT_SHA256="+hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest())
print("PHASE_C_V11_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT="+encoded.decode().rstrip("\n"))
PY
PHASE_C_DIAG_REPORT_RC=$?
if [ "$PHASE_C_DIAG_REPORT_RC" -ne 0 ]; then command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_V11_DIAGNOSTIC_CAPTURE_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE_NO_RETRY' >&2; exit 86; fi
command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_V11_FIRST_API_DIAGNOSTIC_CAPTURE_COMPLETE_NO_PREFLIGHT_RETRY_NO_STEP4'
command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_V11_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_STOP_COPY_RESULT_THEN_DELETE_CODESPACE'
unset PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_RC PHASE_C_DIAG_GH_RC PHASE_C_DIAG_REPORT_RC
